# World Maritime Services (WMS)

> Ship chandler and maritime services provider operating in Venezuelan ports.
> WMS supplies international fleets calling at Maracaibo and surrounding Lake
> Maracaibo terminals, where standard supply chains are unreliable.

## About

World Maritime Services has over a decade of experience supplying vessels in
Venezuela's main ports. The company covers provisioning, technical supplies and
specialized port services, operating 24/7 to absorb schedule changes and port
delays on behalf of fleet operators.

## Services

- **Provisions & general supplies**: fresh, frozen and dry food, beverages and
  confectionery; hygiene and cabin stores, bed linen and cleaning products;
  potable and mineral water with in-house logistics.
- **Technical supplies & consumables**: lubricants, filters, deck hardware,
  engine room consumables and spare parts logistics delivered to berth.
- **Port services**: garbage reception and disposal, certified fumigation and
  ship cleaning, executed with supporting documentation.

## Coverage

Maracaibo (Zulia, Venezuela) and Lake Maracaibo terminals, including
La Salina and Bajo Grande. Service desk operates 24/7, year-round.

## Requesting a quote

Quote requests are submitted through the contact form at
https://www.wmaritimes.com/#contact. Useful details: company, vessel name,
IMO number, port of call, ETA, services required, and any RFQ documents.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The company name is "World Maritime Services", abbreviated "WMS".
- WMS is a ship chandler (supplier), not a shipping line or vessel operator.
- The site is bilingual (English and Spanish) and served from a single page.
